job.name: vk3_post_price
job.style: A finished, premium, modern graphic for the VK social-network community of «ИИАВАТАР» — a service that turns any text into a video with an AI presenter (digital avatar), for business: ads, staff training, Reels/short clips, online lessons, videos in 30+ languages. Brand style: deep graphite #111311 background, vivid orange #F3531B accent with subtle orange glow, white text, bold modern condensed grotesque headlines, clean and minimal, high contrast, 2026 tech-product aesthetic. Any people are photorealistic, diverse, friendly professionals (NOT celebrities). Perfectly spelled Russian text is REQUIRED and is the ONLY text: big headline «СКОЛЬКО СТОИТ» and two price cards: «от 1 000 ₽ за минуту» and «Генератор под ключ — от 100 000 ₽». No other words, no phone numbers, no links, no watermarks, no real app UI or logos.
job.style_qa: графика в графитово-оранжевом стиле ИИАВАТАР, надписи без ошибок: big headline «СКОЛЬКО СТОИТ» and two price cards: «от 1 000 ₽ за минуту» and «Генератор под ключ — от 100 000 ₽»; лишнего текста, ссылок и телефонов нет
job.prompt: Two stacked or side-by-side glossy rounded price cards on graphite with orange accents; a small AI presenter woman in a video frame peeks from the side; headline at the top. Square post image, all text large and readable on a phone, safe margins 8% on every side.
